description: Compressible Ma=0.1 channel baseline. 40x30 mesh, Re~2.21e6.
rationale: Tolerances are loose enough to absorb 64-bit FP non-determinism between runs and between minor SST/EOS code changes, but tight enough to flag a real regression (e.g. solver instability, mass-conservation drift, or wall-clustering changes that shift Cf or T).
note: Regenerated 2026-07-13 on this branch after the two-pressure convention (mechanical momentum pressure, thermodynamic EOS/observables) and the molecular wall transpose coefficient: same converged state within the field tolerances, slower residual path (the EOS k-coupling), so the iteration count moved. The post-merge integration pass regenerates once more on the combined solver.
